title: Element identity reuse during parsing
what: Some parsers create element objects on demand and free them. Identities collected during one traversal are reused by unrelated elements in the next, so an identity-based set matches the wrong nodes.
why_invisible: Parsing succeeds and produces a plausible number, just a wrong one.
detection: Elements are tested directly during a single traversal rather than pre-collecting identities, and page counts are re-derived independently and asserted.
evidence: One filing recorded 535 pages against 162 actual page breaks — a fabricated figure reaching a published field through a bug rather than a decision.
